description: httpd 2.4.69 mod_dav/mod_dav_fs over a fixed two-file/two-collection dataset: multistatus, missing properties, validators and method lists.
substitutions: This records stock httpd 2.4.69 mod_dav/mod_dav_fs, not DocVault's 2009 servlet-backed implementation. Two static files with fixed modification times and two directories stand in for the service's document/collection records.

FileETag is explicitly MTime Size, so file validators do not depend on the container filesystem's inode allocation. DocVault's opaque document-version validators need not have these filesystem-derived values.

DavDepthInfinity is disabled to exercise the documented finite-depth refusal. Stock mod_dav supports more methods than DocVault's fixed layout and does not add its 2016 mandatory-validator policy; conformance records these differences rather than changing that policy.

The exact conditional ETag values were taken from an initial GET of this fixed dataset. Re-recording with changed file content, modification times or FileETag settings requires updating those definition headers from a fresh GET, then recording again; never edit the raw HTTP files.
client: scripts/record.mjs: raw HTTP/1.1 requests over a TCP socket to the container's ephemeral loopback port.

exchanges.name: allprop-depth1
exchanges.description: A depth-1 allprop listing includes the collection, subcollections and both files.

exchanges.name: props-depth1
exchanges.description: Explicit properties include a deliberately unknown property so 404 propstats can be inspected separately from 200 properties.

exchanges.name: options-collection
exchanges.description: The collection's actual DAV classes and Allow methods.

exchanges.name: options-document
exchanges.description: An existing file's actual DAV classes and Allow methods.

exchanges.name: options-unmapped
exchanges.description: An unmapped file name's actual DAV classes and Allow methods.

exchanges.name: mkcol-existing
exchanges.description: MKCOL on an existing collection observes the 405 and its Allow behavior.

exchanges.name: finite-depth
exchanges.description: A missing Depth implies infinity; DavDepthInfinity off produces 403 with an HTML explanation, rather than DocVault's DAV:error element.

exchanges.name: get-document
exchanges.description: The fixed ASCII file's bytes, strong ETag and Last-Modified header.

exchanges.name: get-not-modified-wildcard
exchanges.description: If-None-Match wildcard matches the existing file and returns 304 without content.

exchanges.name: get-not-modified
exchanges.description: The exact strong ETag from the initial GET yields 304 without content.

exchanges.name: put-weak
exchanges.description: The current file's ETag in weak form cannot satisfy the strong If-Match comparison.

exchanges.name: put-stale
exchanges.description: A stale strong If-Match prevents replacement and returns 412.
